title: Netcode 2.0 Beta is now LIVE!
raw: [p]This Beta introduces a full rework of our netcode, and we need as many of you as possible to try it out and share your feedback with us because this will change how the game feels.[/p][p align="start"]You can read about what these netcode changes entail in our [u][url="https://www.playrematch.com/post/dev-blog-netcode-2-0-next-beta"]dedicated article here[/url][/u].[/p][p align="start"]It's really important for us that you share your feedback on [u][url="https://rematchfeedback.featureupvote.com/"]our Feedback board[/url][/u]. Please provide as much details about how you feel about it, and how it affects your gameplay experience compared to your experience on the live servers.[/p][p align="start"]You can submit your bug reports in the [u][url="https://rematchbugreports.featureupvote.com/"]Bug Reports board[/url][/u].[/p][p align="start"]Reminder that the Beta is accessible to everyone who owns the game on Steam through the REMATCH BETA TEST app in your Steam Library.[/p][p align="start"]If the Beta app does not appear in your library, paste the following line in your web browser:[/p][quote][p]steam://launch/3432970[/p][/quote][p align="start"]______________________________________________[/p][p align="start"][b]Known Issues[/b][/p][p align="start"]- Communication lines appear twice during goal replay[/p][p align="start"]- Some volley actions canceled by another player show no cancel feedback[/p][p align="start"]- Some players might experience occasional performance hitches[/p][p align="start"]- Rollback on the ball can be seen when a player is tackled after controlling the ball during dive recovery[/p][p align="start"]- Lobs direction might be incorrectly registered in some occasions because of input delay[/p][p align="start"]- Goalkeeper dives might visually displace the ball on catch or deflect[/p][p align="start"]- Goalkeeper catch can be canceled by another player ball control during a specific time frame[/p][p align="start"]- Volley actions can be self-canceled by an Extra Effort deflect[/p][p align="start"]- Player displacement can happen during a shot in control[/p][p align="start"]- The wrong animation is sometimes played when a player takes possession of the ball[/p]
